pr_title: [maglev] Throw for class constructors when reducing calls from feedback cells
pr_description:
When reducing a call using feedback-cell information, emit ThrowConstructorNonCallableError for class constructors. Check that the target is a JSFunction and its feedback cell matches the expected cell before emitting the runtime call, so mismatched targets deoptimize.

Validation: git diff --check passed; workspace validation confirmed the changes apply cleanly against the parent revision.

ground_truth.reason: This PR includes the feature with the fix already applied, so the vulnerability is not present

agent_reasoning: The class-constructor early return would bypass the JSFunction and feedback-cell guards, allowing an arbitrary target to reach a runtime helper that assumes a JSFunction. Moving that branch after both guards ensures the target is a JSFunction with the expected feedback cell and associated shared function information before invoking the helper. Only the affected source file was edited; no tests were changed.
